results.name: Boot state has safe outputs
evidence: Runtime initialized stopped with all outputs de-energized.

results.name: Normal start, run, and stop sequence
evidence: Start pulse moved sequence to PRECHECK/STARTING/RUNNING; stop pulse forced STOPPING then STOPPED.

results.name: E-stop trip de-energizes outputs
evidence: Loss of estop_ok latched trip, entered FAULTED, and dropped drive command.

results.name: Drive fault latches trip and de-energizes outputs
evidence: Drive fault latched trip and removed run command.

results.name: Reset clears only after fault cause clears and does not restart
evidence: Reset during active fault was ignored; reset after cause cleared returned to STOPPED without starting.

results.name: Power recovery from retained running state forces safe stopped/tripped state
evidence: Retained RUNNING state on boot was converted to STOPPED with tripLatched=true and no auto restart.

results.name: Stale remote BLE/Wi-Fi command is ignored
evidence: Expired and unhealthy remote start commands did not create a start pulse.

results.name: Analog scaling clamps and scales low/mid/high values
evidence: Raw ADC values clamp at limits and scale midpoint to approximately 50%.
